description: The chart illustrates the effect of various language models across different language families, comparing the performance of mBERT and XLM models with different training configurations. The horizontal axis represents the language family categories, labeled as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family category is represented by a group of six bars, corresponding to the models mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, colored in light blue, dark blue, light green, dark green, pink, and red, respectively. The bars within each group vary in height, with the tallest bars generally found in the IE-Indic category, where mBERT-R2 and XLM-R2 reach approximately 16 and 18, respectively, and mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2 reach around 25 and 20, respectively. The shortest bars are mostly found in the Isolate and Uralic categories, with values close to 0. Error bars are present for each bar, indicating the range of variation. The bars are grouped by language family, with the different models represented by distinct colors, and are not sorted in any particular order within the groups.
